recommendations.recommendation: Simplify your life and reduce your needs.
recommendations.rationale: Fewer needs free time and energy for what matters, and the author found it had worked for him.
recommendations.argued_against: Superfluous possessions and busy, unnecessary labor.

recommendations.recommendation: Work only as much as needed to meet necessities, leaving time for thought.
recommendations.rationale: Long labor for superfluous goods leaves little time for living.
recommendations.argued_against: Working long hours to acquire luxuries.

recommendations.recommendation: Observe nature closely and attend to the present moment.
recommendations.rationale: Close attention to nature reveals what is most real and teaches the mind.

recommendations.recommendation: Be true to your own convictions rather than conforming to others.
recommendations.rationale: Living by one's own judgment is the only honest way to live.
recommendations.argued_against: Conformity to the opinions and fashions of others.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not let public opinion or fashion control your life.
recommendations.rationale: Living for approval wastes life on trivial concerns.
recommendations.argued_against: Living as a slave to social opinion.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not resign yourself to a dull life of routine and quiet desperation.
recommendations.rationale: Most people accept a dull existence, but life can be lived deliberately and fully.
recommendations.argued_against: Passive acceptance of a routine, unexamined life.

recommendations.recommendation: Live deliberately, so that you can face the essential facts of life.
recommendations.rationale: Deliberate living brings clarity and prevents waste of life.

recommendations.recommendation: Read the best books and cultivate the mind through serious study.
recommendations.rationale: Great books nourish the mind and enlarge the spirit.
recommendations.argued_against: Neglecting serious reading in favor of trivial pursuits.
